rationale: Hold the entire HTTP request batch. axios is the anchor, but its dependency tree and publish pipeline remain unverified: form-data, proxy-from-env and https-proxy-agent are not in this batch, and the tree-wide licence, install-script and advisory checks are incomplete. follow-redirects is the only confirmed axios edge; keep it only with an exact 1.16.2 pin and a recorded provenance gap. undici, fast-uri, js-cookie, protobufjs and cookie are reported by the requester as transitives of other libraries such as Firebase; their parent chains are unverified, so keep them under monitoring and do not adopt them directly. No package is approved for this requirement yet.
